heading: INT. DUSTY RECORDS - STUDIO B - DAY

units.text: INT. DUSTY RECORDS - STUDIO B - DAY
A converted barn in the high desert.
Egg-crate foam stapled to the walls.
A tumbleweed, a real one, sits in the corner like a joke nobody got around to cleaning up.
Clementine, 30s, boots up on the console, picks at a lap steel.
Abel, 40s, the producer, flannel and tired eyes, stares at the monitor.
Hux, 20s, leans in the doorway chewing a toothpick.
A teenage kid in an apron sweeps the same square foot of floor over and over.
A dog snoozes under the couch.
CLOSE ON the tape machine, reels turning.
that's not what we cut yesterday.
units.name: ABEL

units.text: it's close.
units.name: CLEMENTINE

units.text: it's not close. you slowed the bridge.
units.name: ABEL

units.text: she didn't slow it. i did.
units.name: HUX

units.text: why'd you slow it?
units.name: ABEL

units.text: i dunno. felt right. felt like, you know. like riding in.
units.name: HUX

units.text: riding in where.
units.name: CLEMENTINE

units.text: town. i dunno. i said i dunno.
units.name: HUX

units.text: ANGLE ON the glass.
THE BAND, five men in dusty hats, stand in the live room staring at the control room, waiting.
One of them lifts a fiddle bow and lowers it again.
we ready?
units.name: THE BAND

units.text: not yet.
units.name: ABEL

units.text: you always say not yet.
units.name: CLEMENTINE

units.text: because it's never yet.
units.name: ABEL

units.text: you could just say yes, Abel. once.
units.name: HUX

units.text: i don't say yes to things that aren't finished.
units.name: ABEL

units.text: nothing's ever finished. that's the whole thing about it.
units.name: CLEMENTINE

units.text: The kid stops sweeping.
The dog lifts its head.
Abel stands, grabs his hat, crosses to the door.
Hux doesn't move out of his way.
where you going?
units.name: HUX

units.text: out. air.
units.name: ABEL

units.text: you leave, the take's gone.
units.name: CLEMENTINE

units.text: then it's gone.
units.name: ABEL

units.text: He shoulders past Hux, pushes the door.
Heat and sunlight pour in.
He stops.
WE SEE the red ON AIR light above the door, still lit.
BACK TO SCENE: Clementine's hand is on the record button.
She hasn't taken it off.
She looks at him through the open door, and doesn't say anything.
we ready now?
units.name: THE BAND

units.text: yeah.
units.name: ABEL
